reasoning: Using into to mean not surjective: I is surjective onto (0,∞), since every y>0 has the real preimage x=ln(y)/ln(2). II is not surjective onto Q because x⁴≥0, so −1 has no rational preimage. III is not surjective onto R because 5^x>0, so −1 has no real preimage. Thus II and III only are into functions, agreeing with Math Academy's worked solution.

answers.ma_evidence: Therefore, the correct answer is "II and III only."
